history.content: I'm 23, love dogs, and don't have a car. I need something close to where I live.

Your age meets the published minimum for The Animal Haven’s dog-walker role in North Haven. Its application lists 2 hours per week and a 12-month commitment, but those requirements need confirmation; the organization also asks volunteers to confirm current details. Tails to Trails offers off-site dog walks through the Branford shelter, but the trail location and time commitment aren’t published. Neither listing confirms an open placement or shift.

I can’t tell what’s close without knowing your town. What town do you live in? You can optionally share a ZIP code for approximate distance estimates (it isn’t required). Also, how many hours per week or month could you volunteer, and how many months could you commit?

The New Haven dog-handler application is currently listed as closed.

Thanks—that helps narrow things down. Two dog-related listings name New Haven: adoption-event help (published for the first Saturday of each month, with event venues not specified) and pre-event dog bathing (usually the Friday before; the bathing location needs confirmation). They’re the best local leads, but I can’t confirm either is close to your home. Both are listed as “Confirm with organization,” not as confirmed openings. Their shared volunteer form lists a minimum of 8 hours per month and a 12-month commitment; please check whether those work for you and are still current.

The Animal Haven dog-walking role is in North Haven, so I haven’t assumed it meets your “close by” preference. Do you need to stay within New Haven, or can you travel to nearby towns? You may optionally share a ZIP code for approximate distance estimates; it isn’t required.

How many hours per month could you volunteer, and how many months could you commit?
